code: import axiosInstance from"core/services/api/axiosInstance";const base_url=process.env.REACT_APP_API_URL;const API_URL=`${base_url}sub-categories`;const getSubCategory=async()=>{const response=await axiosInstance.get(API_URL);return response.data;};const deleteSubCategory=async subcategoryId=>{const response=await axiosInstance.delete(API_URL+"/"+subcategoryId);return response.data;};const updateSubCategory=async(subcategoryId,subcategoryData)=>{const response=await axiosInstance.put(API_URL+"/"+subcategoryId,subcategoryData);return response.data;};const createSubCategory=async subcategoryData=>{const response=await axiosInstance.post(API_URL,subcategoryData);return response.data;};const batchDeleteSubCategory=async subcategoryIds=>{const response=await axiosInstance.post(API_URL+"/batch-delete",subcategoryIds);return response.data;};const subcategoryService={createSubCategory,getSubCategory,deleteSubCategory,updateSubCategory,batchDeleteSubCategory};export default subcategoryService;
